scope: The owner's Send click through the Vercel app to Gmail, or to LinkedIn via the Fly browser worker, with state kept in Postgres.
omissions: Finding, research and the hourly pipeline fill
Local scout CLI and X DMs, which the owner sends inside X

notes.title: Single send path, fail-closed
notes.text: Send claims the row (draft→sending) and re-checks Gmail for replies first. If that check fails, nothing is sent.

notes.title: Home exit node is a SPOF
notes.text: If the exit node is offline or the IP matches Fly's, LinkedIn runs stay queued and fail after 24h.

notes.title: Async LinkedIn confirm
notes.text: Sends wait up to 30s. Otherwise they stay 'sending' until refresh confirms them (daily cron plus hourly Fly GET).
